design_principles: High-contrast data hierarchy for quick scanning
Generous internal padding in cards (p-6), tight gap between grid items (gap-6)
Strict grid alignment using 'Control Room' grid layout
Color is function only - UI is mostly monochrome, color exists to guide action

components.buttons: h-10 px-6 rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-300 focus:outline-none
components.cards: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
components.inputs: h-10 px-4 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-950 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 transition-all outline-none
components.table_headers: bg-zinc-50 text-zinc-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4 border-b border-zinc-200
components.sidebar: w-64 bg-white border-r border-zinc-200 flex flex-col h-screen fixed top-0 left-0
components.sidebar_link: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:text-zinc-950 transition-colors font-medium
components.sidebar_link_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-950 font-bold

icons.usage: Use Phosphor Icons (Weight: Regular for inactive, Bold for active states) for dense dashboard layouts.

login_hero_bg.description: Interior view of car dashboard for login screen background

vehicle_placeholders.description: White luxury SUV for vehicle listing
White SUV underground for vehicle listing
White sports car for vehicle listing

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 ratio).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-300`).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind CSS and configure fonts 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Headings) and 'Manrope' (Body). Add Google Fonts/Fontshare CDN links in index.html.
Build the dashboard layout with a fixed left sidebar (250px or 64 w) and a main content area.
Ensure all text is translated to Spanish (e.g., Tablero, Reservas, Vehículos, Clientes).
Use Shadcn UI for complex components like DatePicker (for reservations), Select, Dialogs, and Data Tables.
Apply 'Control Room' bento grid for the Tablero (Dashboard): summary metrics at the top (col-span-1 each), followed by a recent reservations table (col-span-2 or 3) and a small chart widget.
Create a clean Login page using the `login_hero_bg` image with a dark overlay (`bg-zinc-900/40`) on one side, and the login form on the other (split screen).
Vehicle listing should use a card or table view with badges indicating status (Disponible = Green, Alquilado = Blue, Mantenimiento = Amber).
Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, links, form inputs, and key informational elements. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="sidebar-nav-reservations"`).
Use standard HTML inputs if Shadcn forms are overkill, but style them according to the input classes above.
Use Recharts for the reports/analytics charts with the defined primary color (`#2563EB`).
